title_zh: 分区曝光教程来了，教会你可别用来卷我啊。
title_en: Zone Exposure Tutorial—Learn It, But Don't Use It to Outdo Me.

scenes.scene_zh: 开场：有粉丝问什么叫做分区曝光，今天就演示在拍摄中如何进行分区曝光，以及后期应该怎么操作。
scenes.scene_en: Opening: A follower asked what zone exposure means—today I'll demonstrate how to shoot with zone exposure and how to process it in post.
scenes.context: 分区曝光：分区域测光拍摄，后期合成。
sentences: 最近有粉丝问什么叫做分区曝光。
Recently a follower asked what zone exposure is.
The question of the day.
今天我们就来演示一下在拍摄中如何进行分区曝光，然后分区曝光在后期里面又应该如何操作。
Today we'll demo how to shoot with zone exposure and how to handle it in post.
Shoot + post workflow.

scenes.scene_zh: 相机设置：以索尼A7R5为例，按FN进入设置，找到测光模块。多重测光按环境平均亮度测光，多数情况较准，但大逆光时暗部细节不足、高光过曝。
scenes.scene_en: Camera setup: using a Sony A7R5, press FN to enter settings and find the metering module. Multi-metering averages the whole scene and is usually accurate, but in strong backlight the shadows lose detail and highlights blow out.
scenes.context: 理解多重测光的局限是分区曝光的前提。
sentences: 我们目前使用的设备是索尼的A7R5。
The camera we're using is a Sony A7R5.
The test camera.
多重测光它是根据整个环境的平均亮度来进行混合性测光。
Multi-metering is a blended meter based on the scene's average brightness.
Average-based metering.
但是在大逆光的情况下，可能暗部细节不足，高光它还是过曝的。
But in strong backlight, shadows lose detail and highlights stay blown out.
The backlight problem.

scenes.scene_zh: 切换到点测光：选择标准大小，范围小测得更精准。进入主菜单找到点测光，更改为对焦点联动，点到哪里对焦就显示哪里的测光。
scenes.scene_en: Switch to spot metering: choose standard size for a smaller, more precise zone. In the main menu, set spot metering to focus-point-linked, so wherever you focus shows that spot's exposure.
scenes.context: 点测光+对焦点联动是分区曝光的关键设置。
sentences: 这个时候我们选到这个点测光，然后选择它的点测光的大小是标准。
Now select spot metering and set its size to standard.
Spot meter, standard size.
我们把它更改为对焦点联动。
Change it to focus-point-linked.
Link metering to focus.
我们只要点到哪里对焦，它显示的就是这个区域的一个测光。
Wherever we focus, it shows the exposure for that region.
Tap to meter that spot.

scenes.scene_zh: 测光演示：点到窗户显示正二，点到电视显示负一，点到墙和床交界显示负二。这样就能准确知道每个区域该有的曝光。
scenes.scene_en: Metering demo: pointing at the window reads +2, the TV reads -1, and the wall-bed edge reads -2—so you know exactly what exposure each area needs.
scenes.context: 分区测光让亮部暗部都心中有数。
sentences: 比如说现在我点到窗户这里，它显示的是正二的一个曝光。
Point at the window and it reads +2.
Window reads +2.
我选择电视这里，它显示的是负1的曝光。
Point at the TV and it reads -1.
TV reads -1.
我选择这个墙和床交界这里，它显示的就是负二，严重的曝光不足。
At the wall-bed edge it reads -2, severely underexposed.
The edge reads -2.
这样我们就能准确的知道哪个区域我们该是一个怎样的曝光。
So we know exactly what exposure each region should have.
Know every zone.

scenes.scene_zh: 分区拍摄：窗户调到正一（有细节又不过曝），白色床提到正1.3，墙面中间调正0.3，暗部调到正负0.3，椅子负0.3，地板负0.3。分区域各曝一张。
scenes.scene_en: Shooting each zone: window to +1 (detail without blowing out), white bed up to +1.3, mid-tone wall +0.3, shadows around -0.3, chair -0.3, floor -0.3—one exposure per area.
scenes.context: 白加黑减原则下，各区域独立曝光。
sentences: 以这张照片为例，我们首先来测窗户这里，把窗外调到正1，既有细节又不过曝。
Start with the window: set it to +1, detailed but not blown.
Window at +1.
床是白色的，根据白加黑减，曝光相应也应该提高一点，把它提到正1.3。
The bed is white, so per expose-for-white, raise it to +1.3.
White bed at +1.3.
然后就是打到它相对暗部的地方，它现在显示的是负一，我们把它调整在正负0.3。
For the darker areas showing -1, adjust toward -0.3.
Shadows to -0.3.
最后是比较暗的地板，我们也把它曝到一个负的0.3的状态。
The dark floor also gets -0.3.
Floor at -0.3.
根据我们刚才拍的这几张图片，我们对不同的区域都分别进行了曝光。
Based on the shots we just took, each region got its own exposure.
One exposure per zone.

scenes.scene_zh: 手动镜头处理：自动镜头能点屏测光；手动镜头无法显示对焦点，就根据经验用眼睛看各区域想要的亮度，调快门光圈参数即可。
scenes.scene_en: Manual lenses: autofocus lenses let you tap the screen to meter; manual lenses show no focus point, so rely on experience, eyeball each zone's brightness, and adjust shutter/aperture.
scenes.context: 没有对焦点联动时靠经验分区曝光。
sentences: 如果你使用的是手动镜头的话，它就无法在屏幕上产生这个对焦点，让你自由的去点屏幕去测光。
With a manual lens there's no focus point to tap for metering.
Manual lenses can't tap-meter.
这种时候就可以根据你的经验，用眼睛去看你各个区域想要的一个亮度。
In that case rely on experience and eyeball each zone's target brightness.
Eyeball it with experience.
只要调试快门光圈参数，把各区域的亮度调到想要的那个观感就可以了。
Just adjust shutter and aperture until each zone looks right.
Dial in each zone.

scenes.scene_zh: 后期合成：图片导入PS先自动对齐，用中间调曝光0的图打底。窗外过曝，用窗外测光0的图，钢笔工具选窗外区域，加蒙版，把透明度降到70，保留微微过曝符合现场氛围。
scenes.scene_en: Post compositing: import into PS and auto-align, use the 0-exposure mid-tone shot as the base. The window is blown, so take the window-metered 0 shot, pen-select the window, add a mask, lower opacity to 70, keeping a slight overexposure to match the scene.
scenes.context: 蒙版合成各分区最佳曝光。
sentences: 图片已经倒进了PS，我们先对图片进行一个自动对齐。
The images are in PS—first, auto-align them.
Align first.
我们可以用中间调曝光是0的这一张，把它进行打底。
Use the mid-tone 0-exposure shot as the base layer.
Base on the mid tone.
我们使用钢笔工具对窗外曝光的区域做一个选区，然后给它添加一个蒙版。
Pen-select the overexposed window area and add a mask.
Mask the window.
把透明度降到70，让它还是有一点点微微过曝的感觉，才符合现场光比的氛围。
Drop opacity to 70 to keep a slight overexposure that matches the scene's lighting.
Keep a hint of blowout.

scenes.scene_zh: 室内提亮：选床的中间区域那针免补偿的图，盖上黑色蒙版，用白色笔刷涂抹室内（避开窗口和床上高光），把室内提亮，避免过曝。
scenes.scene_en: Brighten the interior: take the +1/3-compensated shot, cover it with a black mask, and paint the interior with white (avoiding the window and the bed highlights), lifting the room without blowing out.
scenes.context: 蒙版刷涂让室内更干净。
sentences: 这一张我们来把室内给它调亮一点，直接给它盖上一个黑色的蒙版，然后使用白色画笔来对它进行涂抹。
Use this shot to brighten the interior—cover it with a black mask and paint with a white brush.
Paint to reveal.
只要不要涂到窗口那个位置就行了，还有床上阳光已经来的这一坨高光，也注意不要涂到它。
Just don't paint over the window, or the sunlit highlights on the bed.
Protect the highlights.
这样的话可以避免它过曝，整体这张图片就比刚才干净了很多了。
This avoids blowout and the image looks much cleaner.
Cleaner result.

scenes.scene_zh: 暗部提亮：用暗部曝光负1.3的图做蒙版测试，透明度降到50%，一层层擦拭——床阴影、地面背光区、墙面、天花板（灯带不刷以免过曝），层次渐进处理。
scenes.scene_en: Lift shadows: use the -1/3 dark-exposure shot with a mask, drop opacity to 50%, and brush layer by layer—bed shadows, backlit floor, walls, ceiling (skip the light strip or it'll blow), processing in progressive layers.
scenes.context: 低透明度分层擦拭，暗部细节自然浮现。
sentences: 对暗部进行曝光补偿是负1.3的一张图片，来进行暗部区域的蒙版测试。
Use the -1/3 shadow-exposure shot for the dark-area mask test.
Shadow-exposure layer.
如果直接去擦的话反差可能会很大，我们把透明度降到50%，一层一层的去擦拭。
Brushing directly would create harsh contrast, so drop opacity to 50% and brush layer by layer.
Layer by layer at 50%.
它床有阴影的地方，还有地面上背光的这些区域，我们也可以把它的曝光给它提起来。
Lift the bed shadows and the backlit floor areas.
Lift the shadows.
天花板我想它透亮一点，把天花板再刷亮一些，这个灯带就不用去刷它了，再刷这个灯带会过曝的。
Brighten the ceiling a bit—and skip the light strip, or it will blow out.
Ceiling yes, light strip no.

scenes.scene_zh: 最终处理：看前后区别，再用暗部曝光图、黑色蒙版30%透明度对暗部补提亮。强光状态下，点测光单独曝光+蒙版擦拭，就能合成出透亮的感觉。
scenes.scene_en: Final pass: compare before and after, then use the shadow exposure with a black mask at 30% opacity to lift the dark areas further. In high-contrast light, spot-metered exposures plus masking compose into a bright, clean result.
scenes.context: 分区曝光+蒙版合成是核心方法论。
sentences: 大家可以看一下前后的一个区别，这个照片又逐渐干净了一个层次。
Compare the before and after—the image has gotten noticeably cleaner.
Cleaner by layers.
我们再用暗部曝光的图片，来进行一个黑色蒙版的遮盖，把透明度调到一个30的透明度，再对暗部的区域进行曝光上的提亮。
Use the shadow shot with a black mask at 30% opacity to lift the dark areas further.
Final shadow lift at 30%.
通过蒙版的擦拭，就可以把照片合成出一个比较透亮的一个感觉。
With mask brushing, the photo composites into a bright, airy feel.
Bright, airy composite.

scenes.scene_zh: 收尾：刷完后高光白色细节不足，把白色阶提一提更透亮，再拉曲线增加对比度；用亮度蒙版选中较暗区域补高光；调整白平衡数值去掉脏颜色，修饰床的皱纹，这张图就OK了。
scenes.scene_en: Finishing: after brushing, whites lack detail—lift the white level for clarity, add a curve for contrast, use a luminance mask to add highlights to dark areas, adjust white balance to remove dirty tints, and smooth the bed wrinkles—done.
sentences: 它的高光可能白色细节不足，我们把它的白色阶给它整体提一提，让它看上去更透亮一些。
The highlights lack white detail—lift the white level overall for a brighter look.
Lift the whites.
然后再给它拉一个曲线，来增加一下它的对比度。
Then pull a curve to add contrast.
Curve for contrast.
我们还可以用亮度蒙版选中它的较暗的区域，给它补一些高光上去。
Use a luminance mask to select dark areas and add highlights.
Luminance mask highlights.
调整图片的白平衡数值去修改一下颜色，把脏的颜色去掉，修饰一下床的皱纹，这张图就OK了。
Adjust white balance to remove dirty tints, smooth the bed wrinkles—and the image is done.
Final cleanup.
